# 🥳 CozyUI Ex，CozyUI+ 的非官方扩展资源包

**English** | [简体中文](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/blob/main/README_ZHCN.md)

![封面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jrC5r3Mp/images/37ebbcdd5ee29548fd194f5e292258055825afa7.png)

![GitHub 仓库星标](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=github) 
[![最近提交](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/commits/main/) 
[![自动打包状态](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/autopack.yml?style=for-the-badge&label=autopack%20build&logo=github)](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/actions/workflows/autopack.yml) 
[![Modrinth 下载量](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cozyui-ex) 
![Modrinth 关注者](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/followers/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth) 
![Modrinth 版本](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/cozyui-ex?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&label=modrinth%20latest)

> ⚠️ 警告！！！
>
> 项目仍在开发中，部分细节可能处理得不够完善，敬请谅解 😥！
>
> **本项目已暂时停止开发。[了解更多](https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/discussions/11)。**

> 请记住，请先**下载 [CozyUI+](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cozyui-plus)**，然后按以下方式加载本资源包……
>
> ![示例](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jrC5r3Mp/images/c7e8d2e10416e33d8a8c35121849be9b9f1e366d.png)
>
> 除非你喜欢那种糟糕的体验。

本资源包将 CozyUI+ 的兼容性扩展至更多模组，并支持愚人节快照特有的 GUI（例如 25w14craftmine）。

## ⬇️ 下载

你可以在 [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cozyui-ex) 上下载本资源包的最新版！（推荐）

想要获取更*每日构建*的版本？在此获取本包的自动打包版本 [此处](https://nightly.link/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/workflows/autopack/main/)！ 

## 🖊️ 额外支持

请在此查看：https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/wiki/Extra-Support

## ❓ 常见问题

请在此查看：https://github.com/WhatDamon/cozyui-ex/wiki/FAQ
